# PM call with President Trump of the United States: 7 September 2026

The Prime Minister spoke to the President of the United States, Donald Trump, this afternoon.

From:
:   Prime Minister's Office, 10 Downing Street and The Rt Hon Andy Burnham MP

Published:
:   7 September 2026

 

The Prime Minister spoke to the President of the United States, Donald Trump, this afternoon.

The Prime Minister began by wishing President Trump a happy Labor Day. [...] On Ukraine, the two leaders agreed on the need to continue working towards a ceasefire that prevented more loss of life. The Prime Minister reiterated the UK’s support for Ukraine and for recent US-led peace negotiations.
